HANDOFFS

    attn seed note <id> -m "…" --handoff   for the next tender. attn seed tend prints the
                                           handoff on the claim. attn seed show lists it
    attn seed standby <id> -m "…"          close your session until the seed gets mail.
                                           --at sets a reminder too; --stay keeps you open.
                                           To wait on the user, ask with attn ask
    attn seed show <id>   prints the seed and its newest entries,
                           which attn seed notes lists whole; --since skips the old ones
